user.title: Lenovo T1 Pro vacuum
user.description: Local control over your network. Do not re-pair or factory reset the vacuum, that changes the local key.

data_description.host: Give the vacuum a fixed IP or DHCP reservation.
data_description.serial: The sn value from any state report or app command.
data_description.user_id: The userId value from any app command.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to the vacuum
reauth_confirm.description: The vacuum refused the connection. Enter the local key again, and check the protocol version. Do not re-pair or factory reset the vacuum, that changes the local key.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the IP address and that nothing else (the app is fine when idle) is holding the connection.
error.no_response: Connected, but the vacuum did not answer. Check the local key, serial number and user ID.
error.invalid_auth: The vacuum refused the key or protocol version. Check the local key and try 3.4 or 3.5 if it was working before.

unknown_room.message: Room "{room}" is not on the vacuum's saved map.

queue_empty.message: No rooms are queued. Turn on the room switches first.

clean_rooms.name: Clean rooms
clean_rooms.description: Clean the listed rooms in order.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room numbers or names, in the order to clean them.

drive.name: Drive
drive.description: Move or turn the vacuum by remote control. It moves in short steps, about 7.5 cm forward or 11 degrees per step, and needs a moment to start. Stay nearby.

clean.name: Clean
clean.description: Clean the whole home. Deep (two passes) and along the walls are untested.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: total, deep or along the walls.

clean_zone.name: Clean zone
clean_zone.description: Clean a rectangle given by two opposite corners in map coordinates. Experimental and untested.

go_to_point.name: Go to point
go_to_point.description: Drive to a map coordinate. Experimental and untested.

state.fail_to_power_off_on_charging_pile: Fail to power off on charging pile
state.cleaning_in_progress_timed_clean_skipped: Cleaning in progress, timed clean skipped

init.title: Options
init.description: Changes reload the integration. Lowering the room slots leaves the extra entities behind as unavailable, remove them in Settings > Entities.

data.slow_poll: Rooms, Wi-Fi and firmware check, seconds

data_description.room_slots: Slot N is room id N on the vacuum's map. Raise it if the map has room ids above the current number.
data_description.state_poll: How often to ask for the status when the vacuum has been quiet.
data_description.slow_poll: Consumables are read at twice this interval.

no_map.title: The vacuum has no saved map
no_map.description: Room and total cleaning are ignored until a map is saved in the vendor app. Run a full clean from the app, save the map, then come back: this notice clears itself.
